newsitem.title: USA: Worldcom to exchange $1.4 bln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Worldcom to exchange $1.4 bln in notes.

text.p: WorldCom Inc said Monday it was offering to exchange up to $1.4 billion of new Senior Notes for two series of Senior Discount Notes of MFS Communications Company Inc.

The telecommunications company said in a statement it would swap $871.60 principal amount of its 9-3/8-percent Senior Notes due January 15, 2004 for each $1,000 principal amount of 9-3/8-percent Senior Discount Notes due January 15, 2004 of MFS.

It said it would also exchange $737.91 principal amount of its 8-7/8-percent Senior Notes due January 15, 2006 for each $1,000 principal amount of 8-7/8-percent Senior Discount Notes due January 15, 2006 of MFS.
WorldCom said its offer will expire on August 4.
Salomon Brothers Inc and Goldman, Sachs & Co are the dealer managers for the exchange offers and consent solicitations, it added.
